title: Procedural Feather System
description: Custom Houdini HDA for generating and simulating feather systems. Used on Maleficent 2 for wing hero shots. Procedural placement, guide-based grooming, Vellum sim integration.

title: Muscle & Skin Pipeline
description: End-to-end muscle rigging and simulation pipeline using Ziva Dynamics. Character deformation from bones through muscles to skin. Built for Rumble's monster wrestler characters.

title: Auto-Rig Framework
description: Modular rigging system built on Maya API (OpenMaya). Space switchers, IK/FK blending, rig validation, batch processing. Used across the rigging team at L'Atelier Animation.

title: USD Asset Browser
description: PySide2 asset browser for USD/Solaris workflows. Stage inspection, custom animation exporter, department handoff tooling. Used daily by 40+ artists at Ghost VFX.

title: Cross-DCC Camera Tool
description: Camera rerack tool that works across Maya, Houdini, and Nuke. Ensures camera data consistency across departments. Reduced camera-related comp fixes by 70%.

title: XGen Grooming Tools
description: Custom XGen grooming workflow tools for hero character hair and fur. Guide manipulation, collision setup, and render-ready export pipeline.
